verdict.rationale: Grok Bot is described as a way to "hand real work to AI teammates on a persistent cloud computer," which points to delegated, persistent autonomous work. Realtime Multi-agent Research also covers multi-step research tasks, though it runs in real time rather than clearly in the background. The evidence is a single overview line with no detail on how tasks run unattended or how results come back for review, and one community report of weak agentic tool calling in an older model (Grok 4) adds some doubt. Missing for 10: documentation of background execution and task lifecycle, a return-for-review or notification workflow, and hands-on corroboration of Grok Bot completing delegated multi-step tasks.
